en: In a vacuum without air resistance, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather fall at the exact same speed.
Even extremely smooth surfaces like glass still experience friction because their microscopic bumps constantly catch on each other.
A magnet will not attract a gold ring or an aluminum can because gold and aluminum are not magnetic materials.
A pulley system makes lifting a heavy box easier by reducing the required force, but the total work done remains exactly the same.
A battery stores chemical energy rather than electricity, converting this stored chemical energy into electrical energy only when connected to a complete circuit.
The moon does not produce its own light, but simply reflects the sunlight that hits its rocky surface into our eyes.
Sound travels much faster through solid steel than through empty air because the tightly packed steel particles transmit vibrations more quickly.
Cold never flows into a warm drink because thermal energy always flows out of the warm drink into the cooler surrounding air.
When a car engine burns fuel, the chemical energy is never destroyed but merely transformed into kinetic energy and waste heat.
A third-class lever, like a pair of tweezers, actually multiplies distance and speed rather than multiplying the input force.
Pure distilled water is actually an electrical insulator that does not conduct electricity, unlike tap water which contains dissolved conductive minerals.
An astronaut's mass remains exactly the same on the moon, but their weight decreases because the moon's gravity is weaker.
